biggest_catch: You only get paid if a stranger buys your listing: fees come off the top, the buyer holds your money until they rate (or three days pass), and the free cash-out takes up to a week.
catches: Mercari charges selling and payment-processing fees that reduce proceeds; the buyer can also dispute during the rating window.
Nothing sells until a buyer buys - listing is free but a sale is not guaranteed; price depends on demand.
Instant Pay costs $3 per transfer; free ACH takes 5-7 business days.
You must ship the item yourself; shipping cost choices affect your net.
Resale catch-all: value varies by condition and demand; quotes and market prices can change; fees or shipping can reduce your actual proceeds.

c1.evidence: Official Mercari help center documents selling and getting paid.

c2.evidence: Official help: ACH bank transfer or Instant Pay cash-out of sales funds.

c3.evidence: Official help: release after rating or 3 days post-delivery; ACH 5-7 business days; Instant Pay ~30 minutes.

c4.evidence: Listing is free; no upfront fee.

eligibility: US, 18+, must own the item; prohibited-item rules apply.
maximize: Price 10-15% above your walk-away number so buyer offers land where you want. Ship within your handling time to avoid cancellation. Use free ACH unless you need money today - Instant Pay costs $3.

payout_quote: Your sales funds are released after the buyer rates you, or automatically three days after delivery; cash out free via ACH (generally 5-7 business days) or use Instant Pay (about 30 minutes) for a $3 fee.

s1.note: Selling fees and the $3 Instant Pay fee disclosed in help articles.

s2.note: Release and cash-out timing stated plainly.

s3.note: Age, ownership, and prohibited-item rules documented.

s5.note: You set the price and see the fee structure before selling.

s6.note: Sale price varies with demand; no sale guaranteed - inherent to marketplace.

steps: List your item with photos and a price (free to list)
Buyer purchases; you ship within the stated handling time
Buyer rates the transaction, or funds auto-release three days after delivery
Cash out: free ACH (5-7 business days) or Instant Pay (~30 minutes, $3 fee)
timing: Funds released after buyer rating or auto-release 3 days after delivery; ACH 5-7 business days, Instant Pay ~30 min ($3).
